entities.summary: Pipilotti Elisabeth Rist, birth name Elisabeth Charlotte Rist is a Swiss visual artist who has attained international recognition. best known for creating experimental video art and installation art. Her work is often described as surreal, intimate and abstract, often depicting the human body.
